title: Tellurion on a turntable
label: Dimetric tellurion: a glowing lamp on a pillar for the Sun, an orbit arm with five spoked gears, and a globe on a wedge bracket with its axis tilted 23.4 degrees, a night half and the Tropic of Cancer highlighted.
caption: Seasons come from the tilt, not the distance: the gear train keeps the globe's 23.4° axis pointing the same way all year, so in June the north leans into the lamp and in December the south does. Drag to walk the arm through the months.
